description.value:
From Bites the Dust · Price: it only works through a willing ally who keeps your secret, and only once per day.

Theme Time

  • 1: Once per day, plant a bomb in a willing ally. The first enemy that Strikes or targets that ally takes @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage with no save, then the bomb is gone.
  • 5: Surge, 2 actions: plant a second bomb today, in the same or another willing ally (only one bomb at a time); the second bomb deals half the damage. When the bomb goes off, everyone within 30 ft except you returns to the space they held at the start of the round.
  • 9: You can choose whether the bomb triggers when it's set off.
  • 13: The ally can reroll one save or check against the triggering creature's effect, keeping the better result.
  • 17: When the bomb goes off, the triggering creature loses its remaining actions this turn, and it starts its next turn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1}.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
